summary.tldr: Authorizes federal spending and transfers for COVID-19 tests and testing equipment.
what_it_does: Authorizes the Minister of Health to make payments of up to $2.5 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for COVID-19 tests.
Authorizes the Minister of Health to transfer COVID-19 tests and related instruments to provinces, territories, and bodies and persons in Canada.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 31 January and received first reading.
